tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: zab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol las: las byang ye shes 'khor lo bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ mi 'gyur don dam thugs rje chen po la: sgo gsum ma 'dres don gyi phyag 'tshal lo: sgrub pa kha skong las kyi khrigs su bsdebs: ma 'ongs las 'phro can gyi dpal du shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum dang po ni: skyabs sems bgegs bskrad srung 'khor byin dbab cing: mchod rdzas brlab dang bshags pa sngon 'gro bdun: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba 'di skad do: na mo: bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can rnams: 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar: rgyal ba yongs rdzogs thugs rje yi: lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hrī: srid mtsho 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las: bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: rigs 'dus thugs rje chen po yi: bskyed rdzogs don las mi 'da' 'o: gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni: hrī: bdag nyid thugs rje khros pa'i sku: dbang chen yongs rdzogs he ru ka: sprul pa'i khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: dam sri log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: nam yang 'da' bar mi nus pa'i: bden gnyis bar du mtshams gcod do: oṃ h+ya grī ba ma hā kro dha sarba duṣ+ṭān bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bzhi pa srung 'khor ni: hrī: gdod nas rnam dag rang byung gzhal yas khang: rig pa'i ngo bo pad+ma he ru ka: dwangs ma'i thugs srog ye shes rnam lnga yi: rang 'od zer grub chos dbyings 'khor lo dang: me long ye shes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbyibs: mnyam nyid dbyings las rin chen 'bar ba ste: sor rtog skyon bral pad+ma'i gur khang dang: bya grub rang byung ral gri 'bar ba'i tshul: sna tshogs mtshon cha'i 'od zer me 'od 'phro: steng 'og phyogs mtshams mi shigs srung 'khor grub: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa haṃ: lnga pa byin dbab pa ni: hrī: chos dbyings rnam dag dkyil 'khor nas: rang byung thugs rje'i lha tshogs rnams: 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs la: dbang skur byin phob dngos grub stsol:

oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya ā: drug pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: hrī: oṃ swā bhā ba bi shud+dha:sarba dharmāḥswā bhā ba bi shud+dho3 haṃ: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū tsa ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya ma hā pū dza ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: bdun pa bshags pa ni: hrī: rtsa gsum thugs rje zhi khro'i lha: ye nas rang byung dbyer med la: gnyis 'dzin rtog pas so sor bzung: mnyam nyid rig pa'i klong du bshags: oṃ badz+ra satwa ā: de ltar sngon 'gro'i rim pa bdun: skal pa can gyis spyad par bya: rtargabha: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim ni: dam tshig bskyed dang spyan 'dren dang: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod: 'dzab bzlas bdun ni dngos gzhi 'o: dang po dam tshig bskyed pa ni: yo ga gsum gyi mngon rtogs bsgom: zhes gsungs pa ltar mngon rtogs kyi lhan thabs ni/ 1$0000250zab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol las: sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 1$0000310 gsang chen lam zhugs thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor las: zab mo'i sgrub thabs yo ga gsum gyi tshul: dkyil 'khor gsum la brten nas bsgrub par bya: dang po ma hā yo ga'i sgom rim ni: ting 'dzin ma yengs yid kyis 'dzin phur gdab: oṃ: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rang rig hrī: de las 'od zer thig 'phros 'byung lnga'i steng: bh+rūm̐ las bde chen lhun grub gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan: rtsig pa lnga ldan pha gu pa trar ldan: drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab kheb tog mdzes: rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes me 'od 'phro: phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor: de dbus pad+ma 'khor lo phyi nang spel:

lte bar thig le zung 'brel mu khyud bskor: mdun gyi thig ler rang rig lha yi sku: thugs rje chen po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis shel phreng bum pa bsnams: rin chen rgyan mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: gsang ye dmar mo pad+ma bum 'dzin 'khyud: bdag nyid spyi gtsug rig bdag 'od dpag med: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag lhung bzed bsnams: mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs chos gos rnam gsum ldan: g.yo med rdo rje'i skyil krung drang por bzhugs: de yi phyi rol pad+ma 'dab bzhi la/ mchan/ shar du mi bskyod thugs rje shel gyi mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje shel phreng bsnams: rin chen rgyan mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: mā kī dkar mo pad+ma bum 'dzin 'khyud: lho ru rin 'byung thugs rje gser gyi mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen shel phreng bsnams: rin chen rgyan mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: spyan ma ser mo pad+ma bum 'dzin 'khyud: nub tu snang mtha' thugs rje bye ru'i mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma shel phreng bsnams: rin chen rgyan mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: gos dkar dmar mo pad+ma bum 'dzin 'khyud: byang du don grub thugs rje in+d+ra'i mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgya gram shel phreng bsnams: rin chen rgyan mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: sgrol ma ljang gu rgya gram bum 'dzin 'khyud: de ltar rang byung zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem zhi ba'i chas dgu gsol: gzhon tshul gzi ldan ye shes 'od lnga'i klong: rang snang ma 'dres thams cad skyil krung bzhugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: zhi ba'i ngang las khro bo'i skur bzhengs pa: 'bar ba'i dbang chen lha tshogs rang byung shar: bcom ldan sku rgyab 'od zer thig le'i dbus: dbang chen yongs rdzogs pad+ma he ru ka: sku mdog dmar nag spyi gtsug rta gdong 'tsher:

zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: dur khrod chas gsol bam chen steng na 'gying: phag mo rang 'dra 'khril sbyor phag gdong ngur: pad+ma'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi yi/ mchan/ shar rtsibs dbang chen badz+ra he ru ka: sku mdog dkar po spyi gtsug rta gdong 'tsher: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje thod khrag bsnams: dur khrod chas gsol bam chen steng na 'gying: phag mo rang 'dra 'khril sbyor phag gdong ngur: lho rtsibs dbang chen rat+na he ru ka: sku mdog ser po spyi gtsug rta gdong 'tsher: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen thod khrag bsnams: dur khrod chas gsol bam chen steng na 'gying: phag mo rang 'dra 'khril sbyor phag gdong ngur: nub rtsibs dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka: sku mdog dmar po spyi gtsug rta gdong 'tsher: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma thod khrag bsnams: dur khrod chas gsol bam chen steng na 'gying: phag mo rang 'dra 'khril sbyor phag gdong ngur: byang rtsibs dbang chen karma he ru ka: sku mdog ljang gu spyi gtsug rta gdong 'tsher: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgya gram thod khrag bsnams: dur khrod chas gsol bam chen steng na 'gying: phag mo rang 'dra 'khril sbyor phag gdong ngur: shar sgor rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dkar: lcags kyu thod khrag 'khril sbyor tshul du 'gying: lho sgor rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum ser: zhags pa thod khrag 'khril sbyor tshul du 'gying: nub sgor pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum dmar: lcags sgrog thod khrag 'khril sbyor tshul du 'gying: byang sgor las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum ljang: dril bu thod khrag 'khril sbyor tshul du 'gying: de ltar rig rtsal khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams: brjid pa'i sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: 'bar ba'i gar dgu rngam brjid khro tshul ldan: bskal me rab 'bar bam chen steng na 'gying: oṃ pad+mān+ta krita ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: de ltar ma hā phyi sgrub bzlas pa'i tshe:

bdag nyid thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥyig dmar: de mthar sngags bskor 'od zer 'phros pa las: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs 'od du bsdus: bdag nyid zhal zhugs thugs kar thim pa yis: sku gsum ye shes lnga yi dbang thob mos: bdag gi rigs 'gre lha rnams kun la sbyar: phung po lnga la rigs kyi spro bsdu dang: zhi sogs las la rigs bzhi'i spro bsdu bya: brgya stong khri 'bum thun sbyar bzlas pa ste: de yis dngos grub yid bzhin 'grub pa dang: zhi sogs las rnams thogs med mthar phyin 'gyur: rigs 'dus phyi sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di: ma 'ongs las ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ : de nas las byang gi sngar gyi 'phror 'di ltar/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren spos rol dang: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: hrī: dbyings kyi 'od 'khyil rnam pa po ṭa la: rig pa'i rang sku bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje mtshungs med yab yum gnyis med sbyor: gnas 'dir thugs rjes dgongs la gshegs su gsol: rig pa'i rang rtsal 'od phung skur snang ba: thig le lnga rdzogs 'brel ba'i gzhal yas nas: ye shes bzhi sbyor rigs bzhi yab yum rnams: tshad med thugs rjes dgongs la gshegs su gsol: dbang drag zla gam 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: ye shes rang rtsal dbang chen yongs rdzogs lha: dmigs med thugs rje'i dbang gis brtser dgongs la: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod kyis gshegs su gsol: las bzhi lhun grub sgo ba yab yum rnams: rtag chad mtha' bral dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren brtser dgongs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrī: chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen gzhal yas 'dir: dbyings kyi thig le 'od phung 'khyil ba'i dbus: rig pa rang shar thugs rje zhi khro'i lha:

mnyam nyid don gyi dbyings su brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: rang rig thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: snang stong skye 'gag med pa'i dbyings nyid du: bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin ye nas bral ba yi: mnyam nyid don gyi ngang du phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: rang mdangs thugs rje'i lha tshogs la: mchod pa'i bye brag 'bul ba ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sgra snyan lha mo rnams: so so'i kha dog phyag rgya bsgyur: rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams bkang nas: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod par bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: hrī: rig mdangs zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: rang byung bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang: sha lnga dam tshig mchog gi rdzas: nang gi bdag nyid dag par bzhes: ma hā a mṛta māṃ sa pañtsa pū dza ho: hrī: thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: snang stong bde chen yab yum mkhar: dga' bzhi ye shes thig ler 'khyil: zung 'jug bde chen mchod pa bzhes: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta pū tsa ho: hrī: thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: rtsa brgyad bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang: bde chen rak+ta'i mchod pa dang: dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa rnams: don dam dbyings kyi mchod par rol: mthun 'jug mchog gi mchod pa bzhes: oṃ ma hā a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: drug pa bstod pa ni: hrī: dbyings kyi 'od phung ye shes chen po las: rig pa'i skur bzhengs thugs rje chen po yab: bde chen dgyes pa bskyed phyir yum dang sbyor: gnyis med don dam rig pa'i sku la bstod: rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' 'od dpag med: rjes su chags pa sku mdog rā ga'i mdog: mnyam gzhag mi 'gyur g.yo med skyil krung bzhugs: rigs mchog yongs rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbyings kyi 'od phung ye shes chen po las:

rig pa'i skur bzhengs rigs bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs: khams bzhi rnam dag yum bzhi 'khril sbyor tshul: rigs bzhi yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: rig pa'i rang rtsal ye shes 'bar ba'i sku: dbang chen yongs rdzogs pad+ma he ru ka: shes rab dbyings kyi phag mo dgyes par 'khril: gnyis med bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos nyid dbang drag lhun grub rol pa'i sku: ye shes rang shar rigs bzhi'i ha ya grī: rang rig phag mo sde bzhi mnyam par sbyor: rta mchog rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshad med rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi ru: phrin las bzhi ldan sgo ba yab yum brgyad: sna tshogs rab 'byams las kun lhun grub pa'i: ta kṛta sgo ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: rig pa spros bral ngos bzung med pa'i lha: cir yang ma grub rang gis gsal ba'i lha: ye nas rang grol rdzogs pa lta ba'i lha: ma bcos cog gzhag rang grol sgom pa'i lha: blang dor rang dag zung 'jug spyod pa'i lha: rang byung ye dag mthar phyin 'bras bu'i lha: thig le chen po grwa zur med pa'i lha: phyi dang nang med kun tu bdal ba'i lha: snang srid rnam dag gzhal yas lhun grub pa'i: chags sdang rang grol zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes sku mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdun pa 'dza' bzlas dgongs pa ni: yo ga gsum gyi mngon rtogs yin: de yi phrin las 'di ltar ro: hrī: rang byung rnam dag gzhal yas 'dir: chos sku thugs rje zhi khro'i lha: sna tshogs sku dang cha lugs la: thugs srog 'dzab kyi rang sgra sgrog: mi 'gyur thugs las 'od zer 'phros: phar 'phros sems can don rnams rdzogs: tshul 'dus dngos grub bcud du bsdu: rtags mthong bar du rgyun mi bcad: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta h+ya grī ba hūm̐: zhes bya zhi khro'i thugs srog sngags: 'dzab dgongs 'dzab dbyangs grangs ldan bsgrub:

de ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa'o: skabs 'dir bzlas dmigs lhan thabs su bkod pa ni/ hrī: bdag nyid thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥyig dmar: de mthar sngags bskor 'od zer 'phros pa las: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs 'od du bsdus: bdag nyid zhal zhugs thugs kar thim pa yis: sku gsum ye shes lnga yi dbang thob gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: zhes pa dang*/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta h+ya grī ba hūm̐: zhes bzla'o// sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu nas bris pa'o// snga ma'i 'phros/ de nas rjes kyi rim pa ni: tshogs dang lhag ma thugs dam bskul: chad tho bsgrag cing brtan ma bskyang: gtor mnan dngos grub blang ba dang: bsdu chog brgyad ni rjes kyi chos: dang po tshogs ni: oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: yi ge drug gi 'phro 'du las: tshogs kyi 'dzin rtog rang dag nas: ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: hrī: gdod nas rang byung rig pa'i sku: snang stong thugs rje zhi khro'i lha: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: gnyis med ngang du brtan par bzhugs: mchod pa ni: hrī: rig pa rang snang zhi khro'i lha: rtsal mdangs 'khor tshogs bcas pa yis: snang ba rgyan shar 'dod yon 'di: blang dor med par bzhes su gsol:

bshags pa ni: hrī: gnyis 'dzin rtog pa a 'thas pas: rig pa lha dang 'dod yon tshogs: mnyam nyid dbyings su ma rtogs pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: bsgral ba ni: rū par dgug gzhug mtha' rgyas bya: hūm̐ hrī: chos dbyings ye shes rig pa'i rang rtsal las: lhun grub las mdzad bud+dha h+ya grī: yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i byin rlabs las: ma rig gti mug gzung 'dzin dgra 'gegs rnams: chos dbyings klong du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: me long ye shes rig pa'i rang rtsal las: zhi ba'i las mdzad badz+ra h+ya grī: yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i byin rlabs las: ma rig zhe sdang gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs rnams: gsal ba'i klong du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: mnyam nyid ye shes rig pa'i rang rtsal las: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na h+ya grī: yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i byin rlabs las: ma rig nga rgyal gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs rnams: mnyam pa'i klong du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: sor rtog ye shes rig pa'i rang rtsal las: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma h+ya grī: yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i byin rlabs las: ma rig 'dod chags gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs rnams: mkhyen pa'i klong du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: bya grub ye shes rig pa'i rang rtsal las: drag po'i las mdzad karma h+ya grī: yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i byin rlabs las: ma rig phrag dog gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs rnams: las grub klong du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: ma rig dug lnga 'dus pa'i ru dra 'di: rig sku ye shes yongs rdzogs he ru kas: sna tshogs rang shar sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs: dug lnga gzung 'dzin rtsad gcod phur bu 'dril: 'khor ba'i rgyun lam chod cig kī la ya: mnyam nyid dbyings su sbyor cig kī la ya: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta kī la ya nṛ tri hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad: bstab pa ni:

hūm̐: don dam chos nyid zhal phyes shig: khams gsum 'khor ba zhal du bstab: ye shes rnam lnga zhal phyes shig: dug lnga gzung 'dzin zhal du bstab: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: bar chad dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: mā ra tsi khā hi: tshogs la rol zhing rdo rje'i glu bya: gnyis pa lhag gtor ni: hūm̐: dbang chen thugs rje zhi khro yi: rig rtsal bka' yi lhag sdud ma: rtog tshogs dbang sgyur 'phrul mo che: 'dod yon rol pa'i lhag gtor bzhes: skye 'gag mtha' bral las mdzod cig: gsum pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung dkyil 'khor chen po nas: rig pa rang shar lha yi tshogs: zhi khro yongs rdzogs skur bzhengs la: shar grol rang mtshang gsal bar mdzod: re dogs mtha' las grol bar mdzod: gnyis 'dzin log lta rgyun chod la: rtag chad mu mtha' bral ba yi: chos nyid klong du thim par mdzod: sangs rgyas re ba'i pho bdud dang: 'khor bar dogs pa'i dam sri dang: tshogs drug yul gyi sde brgyad rnams: skye med chos sku'i klong du sgrol: a phaṭa: bzhi pa chad tho ni: hrī: 'od gsal lhun grub pho brang du: gdod ma'i sangs rgyas thugs rje yis: rang shar dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: 'gyu snang bka' sdod thams cad kyis: rang dam shar grol mtshang bstan pas: bdag 'dzin bral bar ma chad dam: snang rig don gyi gtor ma longs: chos nyid ma la bu thim mdzod: de 'og bskal pa bar ma la: mi 'gyur dpal gyi steng khang du: rig 'dzin pad+ma saṃ bha bas: zhi khro zung 'jug zhal phyes tshe: ma sring dam can rgya mtsho yis: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: de 'og bskal pa'i tha ma la: dag snang dpal ri'i rtse mo ru: mos gzung pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: thol byung nyi zla 'od zer gyis: rtsal snang dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: 'od snang bka' sdod thams cad kyis: 'gyu dran bral bar ma chad dam: 'dod yon rang shar gtor ma longs:

snang stong zung du 'jug par mdzod: lnga pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: bh+yo: dam tshig dbang gis las mdzad ma: rten 'brel bcu gnyis rang dag pa'i: ma mo brtan ma bcu gnyis po: dam las ma 'da' gnas 'dir byon: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: drug pa gtor mnan ni: hūm̐: lhun grub zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gnyis 'dzin dam sri bsgral pa yi: lnga phung snyigs mar gyur pa la: dwangs ma ye shes bro brdung pas: rang grol chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i: skye med rgya yan lhun gyis grub: bdun pa dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: skye med chos dbyings pho brang nas: thugs rje 'gag med zhi khro'i lha: mnyam nyid dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: sku gsum yongs rdzogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sid+dhi hūm̐: brgyad pa bsdu chog la: bshags pa ni: ho: rang rig rnam dag sgrub gzhung las: sems snang 'khrul pa'i nyes pa rnams: gnyis med don dam ngang du bshags: dri med rjen par rtogs par shog: gshegs gsol ni: skye med ngang las gzugs sku'i rol par shar: rang rtsal lhun grub zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: rnam bzhi'i phrin las dgongs pa mthar phyin nas: chos sku rnam dag skye med dbyings su gshegs: bar 'dir bsdu rim dang lhar ldang spyi ltar bya/ bsngo smon ni: 'gyur med dge ba rnam dag bsgrubs pa las: gdod ma'i mgon po kun gyis rtogs par shog: bkra shis ni: hrī: dgongs pa rang shar thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i bkra shis shog: dgongs pa rang shar ye shes 'od 'bar sku: thugs rje yongs rdzogs zhi khro'i bkra shis shog: rang rtsal 'gag med sgyu 'phrul cir yang ston: dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog: ces brjod dga' ston glu gar bya: las rnams kun gyi kha skong ba'i: las byang ye shes 'khor lo 'di: las 'phro can gyi dpal du shog:
sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjes bsam yas steng khang rnam snang gi gsang sgrom nas spyan drangs pa'o// //
